comparison.objective: Tip a counting tray to pour exactly the counted tablets into a vial held off the table while leaving extras behind.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual vessel alignment, small-object pouring, count preservation, and spill avoidance.
comparison.success_condition: All ten counted tablets enter the raised vial, all six extras remain on the counting area, and none spill; later versions latch any spill or extra-tablet transfer as zero. Tablet damage is not graded.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual pouring of discrete bodies and retaining some objects. However, this record relies on prior spatial partition and count-preserving transfer, whereas the candidate tests physical separation by aperture size/orientation, transverse bridging, controlled agitation, and screen reseating.
